title: Costume Structure 솔로 #013 · hourglass bombshell · 해적 × 모노키니 (레이스업 래더) · lambskin · 머리 넘기기 · 가을 공원 · 히메갸루
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a deep ebony-brown complexion, early 30s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, high ponytail dark brown hair — wearing a micro pirate monokini-style costume of ultra-thin supple warm-brown lambskin nappa leather, made of two small triangle cups held by thin halter strings behind her neck and back, joined to the skirt by a narrow lace-up ladder about two fingers wide down the center of her stomach, a black leather cord criss-crossing through small polished gold eyelets from between the cups to the waistband and tied in a small bow at the top of the skirt, a gold buckle at the waistband and a small gold skull charm hanging at her left hip, her waist sides, her flanks, her stomach and the skin around the straps bare, the skirt a micro mini of the same lambskin with a narrow waistband at the top of her hip bones, a plain ultra-high slit cut up the right side of the skirt from the hem to her hip bone, the slit baring her whole right thigh and the side of her right hip, the hem ending just below her hip bones, a micro length hardly longer than a belt, her arms and legs bare, the lambskin shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small beauty mark beside her navel and a small mole near her collarbone. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin lambskin molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the leather cord pulled snug through the gold eyelets and the small gold skull charm swinging at her hip, fine stretch creases and a soft satin leather sheen. Pose: one hand sweeping her hair back, the other resting on her hip, one leg crossed in front to show the boot — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of glossy brown leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, coffin nails each as long as her whole hand, in brown lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, heavy gold rings on every finger, and sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: soft pink blush across the cheeks, sparkling pink eyeshadow, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy candy-pink lips.

Background: a sunlit autumn park with orange trees, a stone bridge with a waist-high parapet and a standard bench on a leaf-strewn path, in warm golden late-afternoon light, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
